entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: A land that sheltered a flock of aven fleeing a ruined continent.

entities.name: New Benalia
entities.description: A realm whose mage-smiths blend steel and enchanted glass into weapons for its elite knights.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: A realm whose walls were built by a peaceful dynastic union.

entities.name: Baird, Steward of Argive
entities.description: Steward of Argive who speaks of the walls built by a peaceful dynastic union.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: A hero whose triumph is chronicled in Triumph of Gerrard.

entities.name: Danitha Capashen
entities.description: A paragon of the Capashen family who vows to protect the less fortunate and love bravely.

entities.name: Seven Houses
entities.description: The Benalish houses interlaced by the loyalty of star-clans.

entities.name: Evra
entities.description: A halcyon witness; Fall of the Thran describes light from the Null Moon taking form.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who lost his sural and his faith in himself on Amonkhet but still knows a bad guy when he sees one.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where Gideon lost his sural and his faith in himself.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A divine being in whom Benalish faith is placed; the unicorns of Sursi manifest her joy and compassion.

entities.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
entities.description: An angel who tells another that they are not alone and that Serra has faith in them.

entities.name: Kwende, Pride of Femeref
entities.description: A descendant of a vanished land and student of a forgotten general, master of blades no smith could forge anew.

entities.name: Brindri
entities.description: A figure raised high by the spirit of Serra and commanded to keep the balance.

entities.name: Shalai, voice of Plenty
entities.description: A speaker who says that when history becomes too mournful even good souls may choose to forget.

entities.name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
entities.description: A follower who says the Ancestor saved them for a purpose.

entities.name: Ancestor
entities.description: A being theologians now believe was another divine form of Serra.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A man whose vengeance centuries ago plunged the world into ice and darkness.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A Tolarian artificer and captain of the Weatherlight who restored the ship and gave Teferi a crystal.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: Grand Warlord of the Keldons who rewards passionate challengers with the Flame of Keld.

entities.name: Naru Meha
entities.description: A master wizard who teaches students to learn and bend the laws of magic.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who tells another their contract is in default and they must serve or die.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who received a crystal charged with his spark from Jhoira, and guards Zhalfir with enchanted statues.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Teferi's lost homeland, once guarded by an army of enchanted statues.

entities.name: Naban, Dean of Iteration
entities.description: A dean at the Tolarian Academy who teaches the history of magic.

entities.name: Deryan
entities.description: A student who saved Hurkyl's editions on restoring physical objects from ash.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: An author of editions on restoring physical objects from ash.

entities.name: Tolarian Academies
entities.description: Academies known for magical research and powerful sorcerers.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The original island of the Tolarian Academy, ruined by experiments.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: Site of the College of Lat-Nam, laid to waste by the brothers; origin of many schools of magic.

entities.name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
entities.description: A fugitive who boasts of making great bad choices and quotes her ancestor Toshiro.

entities.name: Toshiro
entities.description: Ancestor of Tetsuko Umezawa.

entities.name: Zahid, Djinn of the Lamp
entities.description: A djinn who humors mortal wishes.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: The Demonlord, Evincar of the Stronghold and Eternal Patriarch of the Cabal.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A cult led by Belzenlok that spreads from Urborg with nightmares and thrulls.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A land once lovely with volcanoes and lich lords, now gone to the Cabal.

entities.name: Mazeura
entities.description: A figure whose life and work were erased.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: Subject of the book Chainer's Torment.

entities.name: Marwyn of Llanowar
entities.description: An elf who says nature is not always gentle but all life begets life.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: A great forest home to elves, elfhames and kavu.

entities.name: Caligo Morass
entities.description: A vast bog that grew from the forest around the Vess estate.

entities.name: Vess family
entities.description: The family whose estate became the Caligo Morass.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: A Vess who warns not to mistake sunlight for safety; his body was never found.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who sends her brother to sleep and was bound by a contract only death could end.

entities.name: Mister Lostspoons
entities.description: A Skulltown gossip who laments what the Cabal did to Urborg.

entities.name: Thelon of Havenwood
entities.description: Creator of the thallids as a food source in times of darkness.

entities.name: Yar-Kul
entities.description: Belzenlok's lieutenant who grew too ambitious and was transformed into a maggot.

entities.name: Yargle
entities.description: A frog that ate a maggot and grew until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.

entities.name: Whisper, Blood Liturgist
entities.description: A Cabal liturgist who praises the Demonlord's training and trades death for angel feathers.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A mad god who centuries ago offered a simple trade.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: A war whose wreckage gave rats countless breeding grounds.

entities.name: Grimnant knights
entities.description: Knights who bullied an Urborg corpse shop owner and then died.

entities.name: Urgoros, the Empty One
entities.description: A phantom flying over the city of Vhelnish.

entities.name: Vhelnish
entities.description: A city that screams in silence beneath Urgoros.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: A lost lord whose acolytes fight to keep Urborg relics from the Cabal.

entities.name: Ratadrabik
entities.description: A figure whose pustules are sold in a Dark Bargain.

entities.name: Nevinyrral
entities.description: A figure whose pulverized remains are sold as a tincture.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: Warriors of Keld who follow warlords and the Flame of Keld.

entities.name: Kradak
entities.description: The first warlord of the Keldons, given the Flame by the Mountain.

entities.name: Flame of Keld
entities.description: A flame given to Kradak that lights the furnaces of the Keldons' hearts.

entities.name: Valduk, Keeper of the Flame
entities.description: A Keldon keeper of the Flame.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A pyromancer who teaches burning books and warns Chandra of hounds that set people on fire.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: A planeswalker addressed by Jaya Ballard.

entities.name: Ghitu
entities.description: Fierce mages of Shiv who learn the fiery gauntlet first.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A volcanic land of the Ghitu, invaded by Cabal legions.

entities.name: Rundvelt goblins
entities.description: Goblins that have not been so united since the days of Pashalik Mons.

entities.name: Pashalik Mons
entities.description: A goblin from whose days Rundvelt goblins have not been so united.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin who cannot die and boasts of his long life.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: A ruined continent beneath which goblins still work a mine.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A being whose mind grasped for consciousness as rage rebuilt his body.

entities.name: Muldrotha
entities.description: A child of Multani who grew from rot and ruin and bloomed.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest that is one being and awakens with Multani.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker honored in the Song of Freyalise.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: A figure who said nature cannot be destroyed, only changed, as Argoth fell.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: A place whose last defenders fell to Urza's juggernauts.

entities.name: Jenson Carthalion
entities.description: A Yavimaya exile who warns of the primordial wurm.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who speaks of Yavimaya and atoning for his failures.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A barbarian who laid his rage to rest centuries ago.

entities.name: Arvad the Cursed
entities.description: A crew member who will not abandon the Weatherlight and serves at Jhoira's side.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A ship that Jhoira restored and that now cannot planeshift.

entities.name: Adeliz, the Cinder Wind
entities.description: A mage combining Ghitu passion and Tolarian training.

entities.name: Jodah, Archmage Eternal
entities.description: An archmage described in chronicles across the ages.

entities.name: Arkol
entities.description: An Argivian scholar who suggests Jodah may be a title.

entities.name: Shanna, Sisay's Legacy
entities.description: Heir to her ancestor Sisay.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain and ancestor of Shanna who wrote Memoirs.

entities.name: Slimefoot, the Stowaway
entities.description: A mushroom that became Jhoira's first crew member.

entities.name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
entities.description: A druid who feels herself one part of Yavimaya.

entities.name: Tiana, Ship's Caretaker
entities.description: A caretaker of the ship who says nothing is too broken to mend.

entities.name: Niambi, Faithful Healer
entities.description: A healer who says her father will be happy to see you.

entities.name: Rona, disciple of Gix
entities.description: A disciple of Gix who speaks of Urza's machines.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Master of Rona.

entities.name: Alene of Riverspan
entities.description: A resident of Riverspan, a town built on a Phyrexian portal ship's hull.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: An ancient people whose relics and mysteries persist.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: An excavation site guarded by automatons.

entities.name: Vesuva
entities.description: A land whose queen had a helm forged of flowstone.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Creator of a self-replicator that has witnessed history.

entities.name: Talas Incursion
entities.description: An incursion in which Tolaria West wizards aided the knights of New Benalia.

entities.name: Epityr
entities.description: Site of a temple softened by shadows of angelic wings.

entities.name: Sursi
entities.description: A land where Serra's blessing lies strongest and chapels are untouched.

events.summary: Danitha Capashen declares honor rides before them.
events.quote: "Honor rides before us. All we have to do is catch up."

events.summary: Danitha Capashen vows to protect the less fortunate and face despair, as a Capashen.
events.quote: "I will protect the less fortunate. I will love bravely.

events.summary: A knight is dubbed a knight of New Benalia.
events.quote: "Rise, knight of New Benalia."

events.summary: On Amonkhet, Gideon lost his sural and his faith in himself.
events.quote: On Amonkhet, Gideon lost both his sural and his faith in himself.

events.summary: Lyra Dawnbringer says Serra has more faith in you than you have in her.
events.quote: "Whatever faith you have in Serra, she has more in you."

events.summary: The spirit of Serra raised Brindri high and commanded her to keep the balance.
events.quote: "The spirit of Serra raised Brindri high and commanded her to keep the balance."

events.summary: Centuries ago Urza's vengeance plunged the world into ice and darkness.
events.quote: Centuries ago, one man's vengeance plunged the world into ice and darkness.

events.summary: Jhoira recalls learning from Radha how to talk sense into Keldons.
events.quote: I learned that from Radha.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas tells another that their contract is in default and they must serve or die.
events.quote: "Your contract is in default. You belong to me now. Serve, or die."

events.summary: Jhoira gave Teferi a crystal pulsing with his planeswalker spark; he wonders whether it was a blessing or a curse.
events.quote: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's planeswalker spark.

events.summary: Deryan saved Hurkyl's editions on restoring physical objects from ash with only seconds to escape.
events.quote: With just a few seconds to escape, Deryan saved Hurkyl's editions on restoring physical objects from ash.

events.summary: The brothers laid waste to the College of Lat-Nam.
events.quote: Though it was laid to waste by the brothers, many schools of magic trace their origins to the College of Lat-Nam, including the first Tolarian Academy.

events.summary: Teferi received a fire spell's pieces out of rhythm and meaningless.
events.quote: Its pieces reached Teferi out of rhythm, meaningless.

events.summary: Belzenlok's Cabal is hailed with a litany of titles.
events.quote: "All hail the Demonlord Belzenlok, Evincar of the Stronghold, Scion of Darkness, Doom of Fools, Lord of the Wastes, Master of the Ebon Hand, Eternal Patriarch of the Cabal . . ."

events.summary: The forest around the Vess estate became the Caligo Morass.
events.quote: "The forest surrounding the Vess estate became the Caligo Morass, a vast bog stalked by horrors too terrible to name."

events.summary: Liliana Vess sends her brother into sleep as her final gift.
events.quote: "Sleep now, brother. That is the one gift I can give you."

events.summary: Liliana Vess confronts someone who bound her with a contract only death could end.
events.quote: "You bound me with a contract only your death could end

events.summary: Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious and was transformed into a maggot by the Demonlord.
events.quote: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot.

events.summary: The Cabal legions pushed into Shiv.
events.quote: As the Cabal legions pushed into Shiv, they learned not to stand so close together.

events.summary: Kradak was given the Flame by the Mountain and became the first Keldon warlord.
events.quote: The wanderers became Keldons, and he the first warlord.

events.summary: Grand Warlord Radha declares the Keldons do what is best for them, not for the past.
events.quote: We are Keldons!"

events.summary: Multani's mind grasped for consciousness as rage rebuilt his body.
events.quote: Multani's mind grasped for consciousness as rage itself rebuilt his body.

events.summary: Karn tells of Yavimaya being aware but not always awake.
events.quote: "Yavimaya is aware, but not always awake.

events.summary: Arvad the Cursed vows to stay with the Weatherlight and serve at Jhoira's side.
events.quote: My destiny is to serve at Jhoira's side.

events.summary: Jhoira took the wheel of the Weatherlight for the first time in a millennium.
events.quote: As she took the wheel of the *Weatherlight* for the first time in a millennium, Jhoira knew she'd been right to restore the ship.

events.summary: A mushroom in the Weatherlight's hold became Jhoira's first crew member.
events.quote: As Jhoira restored the *Weatherlight*, a mushroom growing in its hold unexpectedly became her first crew member.

events.summary: Teferi enchanted an army of statues to guard Zhalfir; his homeland is gone.
events.quote: Long ago, I enchanted an army of statues to guard Zhalfir.

events.summary: Jhoira tells Teferi the world is healing from its wounds and urges him to heal as well.
events.quote: Everywhere you look, this world is healing from its wounds.

events.summary: Jaya Ballard tells Chandra the hounds prefer setting people on fire.
events.quote: They much prefer setting people on fire.

events.summary: A Phyrexian portal ship was brought down by Riverspan's ancestors, who built their town on its hull.
events.quote: Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull.

relations.quote: "Whatever faith you have in Serra, she has more in you."

the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot
The wanderers became Keldons, and he the first warlord.
My destiny is to serve at Jhoira's side.
Everywhere you look, this world is healing from its wounds.
My child grew from rot and ruin, yet she bloomed.
